quantitative_conclusions: R500 seed320112 best: AbsRel0.09495199, RMSE0.42154055, delta1 0.92499779, F1 0.45920869, band AbsRel0.15658586. Final: AbsRel0.09513670, RMSE0.42341322, delta1 0.92493082, F1 0.45934748, band0.15644831. Seed SD is undefined with only one run, never zero.

R500-R400 best at matched seed: AbsRel -0.00030355 CI[-0.00140604,0.00070504] and RMSE -0.00142435 CI[-0.00783630,0.00494861]; both cross zero. Delta1 +0.00196619 CI[0.00036751,0.00391091] and F1 +0.00781483 CI[0.00498019,0.01097696] improve. Band AbsRel +0.00111808 CI[0.00008312,0.00220744] worsens. A boundary detection gain is not the same as smaller metric-depth errors around boundaries.

R500-R400 final: F1 +0.00879101 CI[0.00603252,0.01200939] and band AbsRel +0.00113255 CI[0.00020421,0.00203248] repeat the detection/depth tradeoff. AbsRel -0.00016227, RMSE +0.00000529, delta1 +0.00211023 all have CIs crossing zero.

R500-B0 both best and final improve all five metrics with scene CIs excluding zero. Best AbsRel -0.02589360, RMSE -0.05414664, delta1 +0.06018214, F1 +0.00805391, band -0.02646123. This is conditional on one trained checkpoint/seed, not a three-seed robustness claim.

Final-best: AbsRel +0.00018471 (0.19453% relative degradation), RMSE +0.00187266, delta1 -0.00006697, F1 +0.00013879, band -0.00013755. All five scene CIs cross zero, consistent with a small endpoint change.

qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0598: R500 reduces overall sofa/floor depth error, AbsRel0.0476->0.0407. qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_1440: Both R models have greater wall/chair/counter depth error than B0. R500 AbsRel improves slightly0.1292->0.1259 while F1 remains about0.519; the main cyan chair-post and counter-edge fragments and yellow false chair structures look almost unchanged.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0226: Both reduce B0 large wall/person scale error. R500 improves AbsRel0.2787->0.2537, mainly broad surfaces; F1 is nearly unchanged0.509->0.512. Major person/column/sofa contours are retained, but displaced branches and missed furniture persist.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0246: A negative data-increment example: R500 AbsRel worsens0.1269->0.1355, both worse than B0. Broader wall/ceiling errors remain, F1 barely drops0.516->0.513. qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0080: R500 improves AbsRel0.0919->0.0892 and F1 0.121->0.237 over R400 by recovering a few extra shelf vertical fragments. Most GT shelf boundaries remain missed even though F1 nearly doubles; the visual gain is local and limited.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0005: Best/final depth-error patterns are similar, final AbsRel0.0548->0.0575 while F1 0.361->0.362. Main chair/table contours are preserved; board boundary remains absent.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0598: Best/final preserve the same tabletop shape and nearly identical matched edges. AbsRel0.0407->0.0417 and F1 0.555->0.550 are small changes, both still better than B0.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_1440: Both endpoints remain worse than B0 in broad depth values; final AbsRel0.1259->0.1299. F1 stays about0.519 and chair-post/counter fragments stay in place; no major endpoint edge loss.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0226: Final reduces broad depth error further0.2537->0.2420 with F1 essentially unchanged0.512. This is a positive endpoint example; branch displacement and missing furniture remain.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Final depth error increases0.1355->0.1439 across broad surfaces, yet F1 remains about0.514 and foreground silhouette is preserved. Boundary detection stability does not imply accurate surface depth.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Final loses a few small matched shelf fragments, predicted edges192->168 and F1 0.237->0.218, with AbsRel0.0892->0.0904. This is a limited local regression, not the near-total disappearance seen in some earlier L/J endpoints.

interpretation: This first R500 seed has stable endpoint behavior, depth improvement versus B0, and a small boundary-detection gain over R400 at the cost of slightly worse boundary-band depth error. The overall AbsRel increment is uncertain. Wait for both remaining seeds and other routes before ranking data efficiency.
